setupGuide.title: Getting Started — 5-Step Setup Guide
setupGuide.subtitle: Follow these 5 steps in order to set up your classes and start evaluating students.
setupGuide.allReady: All 5 setup steps are complete! You are ready to evaluate sessions.
setupGuide.step1Desc: Define how often classes meet (e.g. Weekly, Monthly) on the Schedule page.
setupGuide.step2Desc: Add at least one teacher to your roster.
setupGuide.step3Desc: Create the evaluation criteria (e.g. Speed, Rhythm, Focus) you will score.
setupGuide.step4Desc: Add students and organize them into a class group.
setupGuide.step5Desc: Assign a teacher + interval + group on Schedule, then generate session dates.
